environment.status: adapted reference, not recovered historical environment
environment.library_policy: Only the owned library and native base/recommended library; no user/site library or modification to product .venv. Explicit .libPaths and R_LIBS/R_LIBS_USER inside R also propagate to PSOCK workers.
environment.dependency_policy: Resolve remaining dependencies against the native CRAN R4.4 binary index, preserve index/download hashes and installed versions before author science. Install journal TSCI and source pins unchanged. No author-source or compiler-error patch, automatic dependency substitution or execution retry.
environment.known_adaptations: Current binary candidates Rfast 2.1.5.2 and ranger 0.18.0 differ from paper versions 2.1.0 and 0.16.0. The old Rfast Makevars links native R's FLIBS, whose /opt/gfortran paths do not exist here; no old Rfast build was attempted. Its and ranger's old source archives were inspected/downloaded only. Native R's recommended MASS also differs. Exact final dependency resolutions must be frozen separately before execution.
environment.build_configuration: MAKEFLAGS=-j2; R_MAKEVARS_USER and R_MAKEVARS_SITE=/dev/null; use upstream package configure without edits. Record compiler/OpenMP diagnostics, including serial compilation if upstream chooses it.
environment.on_preparation_failure: Preserve exact logs and partially populated library; no author science until explicit readiness. No claimed historical lock or numerical reference.

execution.initial_output_directory: fresh; no cached output or fitted objects copied
execution.threads: one BLAS/OpenMP thread per process; original five PSOCK workers retained
execution.seed: Unchanged script sets L'Ecuyer-CMRG and 10 before its five-split boosting example; subsequent example retains original RNG continuation.
execution.warnings: Capture conditions and full raw source output without suppressing them. Preserve partial environment and error after failure; do not rerun the author science to recover missing metadata.
execution.on_failure: Record terminal exit, raw diagnostics and partial outputs; no patch, reduction to an easier subsection, source rerun or changed acceptance threshold.

inspection: Require authoritative process termination and unchanged script/archive bytes.
Inspect all produced objects and warnings; do not equate process exit zero with scientific acceptance.

Read published summaries on pages 11-13 and 15 at their displayed precision before execution. Compare selected/per-space estimates, intervals, p-values, selection/strength counts and sample/split dimensions; report discrepancies, not a post-result fitted tolerance.
Record Card data identity, row/column shape, missingness and actual package locations. The empirical data do not reveal a known causal truth.
Do not treat source algorithms' split substitution, valid/invalid labels or their numerical agreement as an assumption audit or proof of causal validity.
Keep numerical reproduction authority separate from independent mathematics, general theory benchmark qualification and agent autonomy.
freshness: No TSCI, curvature-identification or Card-data match found in inspected public question/development records. A consumed valid-IV linear GMM task exists, so shared IV background and future grouping require explicit review. This preparation neither certifies a fresh independent theory family nor activates or assigns a publication split.
excluded_scope: original 2022/2024 theory paper simulations or theorem correctness
blind theory rediscovery or target-paper contamination removal
full environment recovery, archive redistribution or a new product capability claim
model calls, candidate evaluation and official publication comparisons
